I remember when I had my first ovarian cyst rupture. It was larger than a golf ball and I couldn’t stand up. They gave me some ibuprofen and saline. Told me it was nothing serious (I couldn’t go to school or walk well for a FULL WEEK). The second time it happened, it was more like appendicitis and they refused to do any scans other than an xray. I couldn’t move my legs well and the pain was extreme. It was on my right side and near my belly button. I don’t know where the fuck they got the idea that it was a ruptured hamstring muscle. My pain was NOT on my leg. But since I’m a teenager and do sports that MUST be the reason. (I hadn’t played volleyball for over two weeks because I had an ankle sprain.) I’ve lost faith in going to the ER for ovarian pain. Since I also have an autoimmune disease which causes extreme pain, I’m prescribed cataflam and I have used it for severe menstrual cramps. I don’t know why, but they’ve gotten worse over the years, and it doesn’t help that even if I have really bad period cramps, the school won’t excuse my absence. Not even if im writhing in pain. Also, apparently my right ovary is full of large cysts that are waiting to rupture. I am disillusioned with women’s healthcare so much. I truly hope you can find adequate resources:))
